Status: partial. (a) is cache-blocked with reason; dependency-free smoke passed. (b) M3 plan complete.

## (a) AudioSeal cost: MPS vs CPU per 10 s — blocked, with analysis

Machine: Apple M1, macOS 27.2 (Darwin 27.2.0).

Blocked: no torch on this Mac, no cached AudioSeal weights
anywhere (`find / -name generator_base.pth` empty,
`~/.cyv` absent). Fetching torch (~200 MB+) plus
93 MB of weights (`models.toml`: generator 58.8 MB,
detector 34.7 MB) would break the no-large-download rule.
So no real MPS or CPU AudioSeal number was measured here.

What ran: dependency-free smoke in `/tmp/cyv-wm-LomuGE`
(numpy 2.3.5 installed to that dir only, repo untouched):

- `message.py`: `CYV_MESSAGE=0x1177`, version=1 flags=1 crc ok.
  All 16 single-bit flips rejected by CRC.
- `dsp.py` on synthetic 10 s @48 kHz: resample 48k->16k,
  `fit_length`, `add_residual` all correct shape/dtype/clipped.
- Steady-state numpy cost per 10 s: ~9 ms total
  (downsample ~5 ms, upsample+add ~4 ms).
  First call was ~0.3 s (FFT/Accelerate init) — one-off.

Key finding for the spike: `audioseal_wm.py` does resample
and residual-add in numpy on CPU, torch only for the
forward pass. So on MPS the CPU-fixed cost is ~10 ms;
the torch forward is the whole question.

Code-path estimate (labelled, not measured):

- Sizes imply roughly ~14.7 M params generator,
  ~8.7 M detector (fp32 bytes/4). Both fully convolutional,
  cost scales linearly with frames (detector emits
  1×18×500 frames per 10 s at 16 kHz).
- Linux reference (loaded 4-vCPU Xeon, noisy):
  embed 4.4 s, detect 6.1 s per 10 s audio.
- MPS guess: forward likely falls to roughly 0.5–1.5 s
  per 10 s on M1 (small conv nets are bandwidth-bound;
  softmax/normalizer/per-frame ops are MPS-friendly).
  Risk: some conv/upsample op falls back to CPU —
  keep `PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1` per DESIGN §3.

To unblock: run `cyv setup` (torch + audioseal + weights),
then time `embed`/`detect` on quiet M1 with
`device="cpu"` vs `"mps"` using the existing
`scripts/bench/b4_watermark_bench.py` pattern.

Note: AudioSeal's loader uses unsafe unpickling —
accepted only for the sha256-pinned checkpoints in
`src/cyv/models.toml` (DESIGN §11). No change made.

## (b) M3 `cyv watermark detect <file>` — minimal plan

Consistent with ADR-004 (`Watermarker.detect` already exists;
M3 is pre-approved in DESIGN §9, no new ADR).

Detector API (no change needed):

- `cyvd/interfaces.py` `Watermarker.detect(audio)`
  returns `(prob, message|None)`.
- `audioseal_wm.py` threshold 0.5, per-frame decode,
  `message_is_cyv()` CRC check via `message.unpack`.
- `fakes.py` `FakeWatermarker.detect` already stubbed.

Files to touch:

1. `src/cyvd/server/pipeline.py` — add
   `Pipeline.detect(wav: bytes) -> dict`
   (`decode_wav` + `self.watermarker.detect` +
   `message_is_cyv`; no voice needed).
2. `src/cyvd/server/main.py` — add `detect` op handler
   (binary frame in like `convert`, JSON-only reply:
   `{ok, prob, message, crc_ok, backend}`).
   Reuse the GPU worker queue (torch/MPS, serialized).
3. `src/cyv/protocol.py` — document the `detect` op.
4. `src/cyv/client/core.py` — add
   `Client.detect(wav_bytes)`.
5. `src/cyv/cli/main.py` — add `watermark` group with
   `detect <file>` (`-` = stdin). Reuse `_is_pcm16_mono_wav`
   fast path + `ffmpeg.to_wav` (keeps the pipe-protocol
   whitelist; daemon still never takes paths).
   Print `watermarked prob=1.00 message=0x1177 (crc ok)`
   or `no watermark (prob=0.03)`; consider `--json`.
6. Tests: `tests/test_daemon_client.py` (detect op
   round-trip), `tests/test_cli.py` (parse/output),
   `tests/test_components.py` (extend the existing
   FakeGen/FakeDet pattern, lines ~99–139, plus a
   `Pipeline.detect` unit test with `FakeWatermarker`).
7. `docs/benchmarks/` — add detect timing entry
   (repo rule: watermark work needs a benchmark note).

No CLI `watermark` command exists today (verified:
subcommands are setup/doctor/dataset/voices/say/convert/
serve/stop/status; daemon ops are health/say/convert/
reload/shutdown).
